profile.title: My Profile
profile.subtitle: Your identity, billing details and account security.

billing.title: Billing details
billing.note: This is the name and address that appears on your invoices and receipts.

security.title: Security
security.passwordHint: Use a strong, unique password of at least 8 characters.
security.twoFactorBody: Require a one-time code from your phone at sign-in.
security.twoFactorNotReady: Two-factor authentication needs a backend — not wired up yet.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.signOutEverywhereBody: Ends every active session on all your devices.
danger.signOutNotReady: Signing out other devices needs a backend — not wired up yet.
danger.deleteAccountBody: Terminates every deployment and forfeits any remaining credit.
danger.deleteConfirmBody: Every deployment is terminated and any remaining credit is forfeited. This cannot be undone.
danger.deleteNotReady: Account deletion needs a backend — not wired up yet.

limits.title: Usage Limits
limits.subtitle: Guardrails on what this account can spend and run.
limits.balanceLoadFailedBody: We could not load your balance just now. The figures below may not be current.
limits.notEnforcedTitle: Spend caps and concurrency limits aren't enforced yet
limits.notEnforcedBody: These controls are saved locally for now. Auto top-up is live — the rest take effect once the backend lands.

wallet.title: Wallet controls
wallet.description: Only apply if you fund this account with credit — how your balance tops itself up, and when you're warned it's running low.
wallet.keepToppedUpBody: Charges your default card automatically so deployments never pause.
wallet.topUpByBody: How much credit to add each time it triggers.
wallet.lowBalanceAlertBody: Email me when the balance falls under this amount.
wallet.triggerBelowBody: The threshold that starts an automatic top-up.

controls.title: Usage & spending controls
controls.description: These cap what actually runs, so they hold regardless of whether you're paying from a credit balance or a monthly invoice.
controls.monthlyCapBody: Leave empty for no cap. Counts usage charges, not top-ups.
controls.pauseAtCapBody: Stop everything when the cap is hit instead of only warning you.
controls.maxConcurrentBody: Leave empty for unlimited. Blocks new deployments past this count.
controls.maxHourlyRateBody: Blocks hardware tiers that cost more than this per hour.
